system.name: DistServe
system.one_liner: an LLM serving system that disaggregates prefill and decoding onto separate instances to optimize goodput

components.name: Controller
components.role: centralized FCFS controller that dispatches requests to the shortest-queue prefill instance, then to the least-loaded decoding instance

components.name: Prefill Instance
components.role: runs the prefill phase of an LLM request

components.name: Decoding Instance
components.role: runs the decoding phase of an LLM request after receiving its KV cache

components.name: LLM Model
components.role: the model definition served by each instance

components.name: GPU
components.role: compute devices executing the parallel runtime for an instance

components.name: Parallel Runtime
components.role: the parallel execution runtime (spanning multiple GPUs) backing each instance

content.key_idea: Prefill and decoding are served by physically separate, independently parallelized instance pools, with a central controller dispatching by queue length/load and a dedicated KV cache transfer step handing state from prefill to decoding.
content.reading_order: Left to right: Requests enter the Controller at top, which dispatches down into the Prefill Instance stack on the left, whose KV cache is transferred rightward into the Decoding Instance stack.

summary: This figure depicts the runtime architecture of DistServe, an LLM serving system that disaggregates prefill and decoding computation onto separate instance pools. Incoming requests first reach a centralized Controller, which uses simple FCFS dispatch: it routes each request to the Prefill Instance with the shortest queue, and after prefill, to the least-loaded Decoding Instance. Each instance (shown as a stack of offset boxes to indicate a pool of several instances) contains an LLM Model, a set of GPUs, and a Parallel Runtime that together execute that phase. A KV Cache Transfer arrow connects the Prefill Instance stack to the Decoding Instance stack, representing the hand-off of attention state between the two disaggregated phases. The diagram is a compact, flat-filled boxes-and-arrows architecture drawn with a pastel red/yellow/green/blue palette and square corners.
summary_zh: 该图展示 DistServe 的运行时架构：请求先到达中心化控制器，按 FCFS 策略分派给排队最短的预填充实例，再分派给负载最低的解码实例，二者之间通过 KV Cache Transfer 传递缓存，每个实例包含模型、GPU 与并行运行时。
